records.title: Hardware-aligned Hierarchical Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-term Memory Access
records.reason: Adds hierarchical sparse attention and hardware-aligned kernels to recurrent models, enabling efficient retrieval from long contexts with near-constant memory.

records.title: Beyond Accuracy and Cost: Latency-Aware LLM Query Routing for Dynamic Workloads
records.reason: Combines estimated TTFT with accuracy and cost in a router that assigns LLM queries across instances under dynamic workload and serving conditions.

records.title: Streaming Kernel PCA Algorithm With Small Space
records.reason: The title identifies a small-space streaming Kernel PCA dimensionality-reduction algorithm and gives no concrete connection to LLM inference, Transformer serving, compression, or deployment efficiency. This is a permitted title-only exclusion for an unambiguously unrelated candidate.

records.title: MetaLA: Unified Optimal Linear Approximation to Softmax Attention Map
records.reason: Develops a linear-attention approximation designed to capture dynamic memory and static approximation behavior, targeting lower-complexity Transformer sequence modeling.

records.title: Speculative Verification: Exploiting Information Gain to Refine Speculative Decoding
records.reason: Adds a companion model to estimate draft-target alignment and adapt verification length, reducing wasted speculative decoding work; the ACL version confirms the same authors and method under a shortened title.

records.title: Pyramid-BERT: Reducing Complexity via Successive Core-set based Token Selection
records.reason: Uses core-set token selection to shorten intermediate Transformer sequences in BERT-style classification/ranking, reducing compute and supporting longer inputs.

records.title: TreeGraft: Adaptive Multi-Drafter Grafting for Tree-Based Speculative Decoding
records.reason: Coordinates multiple drafters with a lightweight scheduler to construct better speculative token trees while controlling additional drafting cost.

records.title: A Survey on Model Compression and Acceleration for Pretrained Language Models
records.reason: Surveys inference-stage compression and acceleration for pretrained language models, motivated by high inference delay, energy use, and edge deployment costs.

records.title: Addressing Activation Outliers in LLMs: A Systematic Review of Post-Training Quantization Techniques
records.reason: Systematic review focuses on activation outliers and weight-activation post-training quantization methods to make LLM inference more efficient.

records.title: MassAlloc Attention: Let Attention Allocate Its Own Compute
records.reason: MALA uses normalized attention contribution to adaptively omit low-value post-score work, reducing attention operator latency while maintaining output/gradient accuracy.
